high_level_description: The image is a composite of two photographs with accompanying text at the top. The text reads: "In 2019, a Japanese university student studying ninja history submitted an essay in invisible ink, visible only when heated. Her professor gave her an A after heating part of it, leaving some unheated for media interest." The left photograph shows a young woman holding an open scroll-like document. She is smiling and appears to be in a classroom or lecture hall setting, as indicated by the wooden desks and chairs in the background. She is wearing a dark floral-patterned blouse.
